name: com.starhermit.sdk
description: Typed, asynchronous Unity client for the Starhermit REST v1 and WebSocket v1 APIs: authentication, profile, friends, chat, voice, catalog, entitlements, cloud saves, achievements, leaderboards, authoritative games, realtime rooms, peer relay and publishing.

samples.description: OAuth and public-key adapters, session UI, terms, avatar and presence heartbeat.
Friend requests, conversations, unread state, live chat and reconnect.
Launch token, matchmaking ticket, session, game socket, settings, controls and replay.
Lobby seats and teams, quick join, binary peer traffic and host loss.
Permissions, room lifecycle, PCM fallback, mute and speaking state.
Search, entitlement, download, activity, rating, wishlist and cloud-save conflict.
Typed publisher operations and streaming WebSocket bundle upload.
Invoke-key exchange, server-token isolation, session lookup and clean shutdown.
